item.title: A Towel for Lane Four
item.summary: A swimming class notice shows what to bring and where to wait.
item.content_markdown:
Our Saturday swimming class starts at ten. Please come to the pool at a quarter to ten. Bring a towel and a bottle of water. You do not need to bring a ball. The teacher has three yellow balls in a bag.

Put your shoes in a box by the main door. Keep your towel on the bench beside lane four. The other benches are for people in the earlier class. Their class finishes just before ours.

Please wait on the bench until the teacher calls your name. If you come after ten, ask at the front desk before you go to the pool. The teacher will tell you when you can join the group. When the lesson ends, you can use the shower by the big window. The shower by the door is closed today.

questions.prompt: What information does the notice give?
options: What to do at a swimming class
How to buy a pool ticket online
How to ask for a new teacher
Where to watch an evening race
questions.explanation: It lists what to bring, where to wait and what to do around the lesson.

options: At nine

At ten

questions.prompt: Where should students leave their shoes?
options: On the bench beside lane four
By the big window
At the front desk
In a box by the main door
questions.explanation: The second paragraph puts shoes in a box by the main door.

questions.prompt: What should a student who comes at ten past ten do first?
options: Take a ball from the bag
Ask at the front desk
Go straight to the teacher
Wait by the shower
questions.explanation: Anyone who comes after ten should ask at the front desk before going to the pool.

questions.prompt: Students need to bring their own ball.
questions.explanation: The teacher already has three balls.

questions.prompt: The bench beside lane four is for this class.
questions.explanation: The notice tells these students to put towels there.

questions.prompt: The lesson is forty minutes long.
questions.explanation: The notice gives the start time but no length or finish time.

questions.prompt: Complete the sentences with words from the passage.
questions.text: Keep your towel on the ___ beside lane four. After the lesson, use the shower by the big ___.
questions.explanation: The second paragraph gives the towel place; the last gives the open shower.

questions.prompt: Choose the best heading for each numbered paragraph.
options: What to do beside and after the lesson
What to bring and when to come
Where to leave shoes and towels
What the tickets cost
questions.explanation: The paragraphs give arrival details, storage places and the rules beside the pool.
